_about: MINEHEAD: Room Review MINEHEAD/1 (Josh, 2026-10-09): the platform's underside (37-mineplab) painted a light grid. Its bright cells are now real holes, and a light high above shines through them, so the grate's bars throw the grid down onto the wall and floor beneath. The platform's top slab (38-mineplat) casts no shadow, so that light reaches the grate.

holes._note: the two grid panels' bright cells (about 2,700 texels of 256x128): stable from 90 to 170, the bars and rust stay solid

_noCast: 38-mineplat: the slab over the grates. 34-minesmas (round 18): the crusher (mh_smasher) stands on the platform right over the LEFT grate (x -247..-159, y 181..350) and shadowed its whole grid -- the original art paints light through both grates, so it casts no shadow now

volume._about: Round 18 (Josh): the dark volumetric shadows the original art painted in (39-minewal1's and the rest), now that the new clean textures no longer carry them -- as CORICORI: black air that absorbs with distance, lit by the lights as they pass; paint = thicker black where the ORIGINAL art is painted dark (built from the original pixels, so the new textures change nothing).
volume._round19: Josh: way too dark -- a brighter room than the caves. Thinner fog (density 0.004 -> 0.0018, max 0.78 -> 0.55), the room level held higher (0.82 -> 1.0), the painted darkness softer (0.02 -> 0.01, max 0.85 -> 0.55): its shading stays, it no longer swallows the room.
volume._round21: Josh (2026-10-09): no beige fog -- only the dark fog in the corners. The air itself is clear (density 0); the painted darkness (paint, black) alone remains, where the original art paints its corners and edges dark.

_round21: Josh: no drips (the cave class adds them) and no pale ground mist (the misty class) -- the dark corners only; floating specks in the grate light (lights[0].dust) plus the room's dust motes (cave class)

artLight._about: Round 20 (Josh, MINEHEAD/2-4): the light and shade the ORIGINAL art paints, read per texel and shading the room level and the bounce: the platform's hard shade on the wall beneath it (39-minewal1's dark upper half), dark corners and edges, the rest at the art's well-lit level, in its colour
artLight._round22: Josh, MINEHEAD/5: too hot a palette -- the warm fill tint (#FFDECC) is off, and the three warm pool lights are gone; the grate light (MINEHEAD/6) is the room's one light

gi._about: Round 19 (Josh): bounced light. A brighter room, so the gentlest room-level cut yet (ambient 0.85; the caves use 0.4-0.6).
gi._tuned: first pass (strength 2.5, pools 1.3) clipped the floor and pillars to white; strength 1.8, pools 0.85
